name: Wisp fitting room
scope: Approved first milestone; example-local product facts only.
purpose: Try one badge on one humanoid wisp and see a reversible geometric transformation.
audience: People exploring a small character customization prototype; future adopters studying reusable asset boundaries.
approved: Accessible HTML equip and unequip controls
future: A reusable asset library and themed combinations are later milestones, not implemented here.
contracts: No changes to the root adoption payload
Pure morph and equipment logic is independent of DOM and Three.js
Actual geometry deformation, not character swaps or whole-group scaling
Static illustrated forms remain usable without WebGL
